title: IRIS: Intent Resolution via Inference-time Saccades for Open-Ended VQA in Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper describes a training-free approach to resolve referential ambiguity in VQA using eye-tracking. While it includes an 'Ethics statement' (Section A.8) regarding IRB approval and participant recruitment, this is standard administrative disclosure and the paper does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as part of its research goal.
